title: Front-arc facing: while retreating/healing/hiding and hit in the last 2 s by a visible mech, keep that attacker in the torso's front 180 deg arc on non-firing ticks (FACE_ATTACKER_ON)
behaviors: on a non-firing tick after t >= 10 s, with no drop called and in retreat / heal / hide mode, when a mech that damaged us in the last 2 s is in view and outside 45 deg of the torso aim we would command, turn the torso just enough to put it within 45 deg; legs, path, retreat/heal thresholds and targets unchanged
